topic: Best Scalping Setups for Low Float Stocks
notes: What are your go-to scalp setups? Been working on sub-minute entries on 1-5M floats with high RVOL. Thinking about risk management - do you scale in or all-in?
Discussing the classic gap and go setup. Looking at historical data, what time frame do these usually consolidate in? Pre-market moves vs open moves?
Let's break down different VWAP approaches. I use VWAP as support/resistance but curious about other traders' methods. Anyone use VWAP crosses?
How do you identify which fades work? I see a lot of HOD failures that turn into runners. Any specific criteria you use to filter?
Most important rule - always know your exit before entry. Position sizing formula: 2% per trade max. Fixed dollar stops beat percent stops always.
